text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 22 cm across in the photo (about 340 px). That works out to about 0.065 cm per px.

Corn: there are two pieces, each a cob segment about 75 px across, or about 5 cm, and 3-4 cm long. Each weighs about 50-60 g, so the two together come to roughly 110 g. Corn on the cob has about 95 kcal per 100 g, and the cob itself adds weight, so I'll use 90.

Spinach salad: a small handful of about 20 g, plus shredded carrot at about 5 g.

Tomatoes: two cherry tomatoes at about 12 g each, so 25 g.
